name: Wisdom Marine Lines Co., Limited (Cayman)
summary: Wisdom Marine Lines Co., Limited (Cayman), together with its subsidiaries, provides marine cargo transportation services in Singapore, the Netherlands, Germany, Panama, Switzerland, Denmark, and internationally. The company acquires, owns, operates, and manages dry bulk vessels with a focus on the handy sector. It also provides vessel management and maintenance, vessel leasing, and shipping agency and management services. In addition, the company offers wet lease contracts, which include complete crew, maintenance, and insurance.
